name: pi-packages
description: Pi packages for transcript navigation and source-aware IntelliSense

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix packages/pi-tab-focus && npm ci --prefix packages/pi-intellisense
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix packages/pi-tab-focus && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/pi-intellisense
scripts.build: npm run typecheck --prefix packages/pi-tab-focus && npm run build --prefix packages/pi-intellisense
scripts.test: npm test --prefix packages/pi-tab-focus && npm run test:all --prefix packages/pi-intellisense
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test:all
